deadline.value: Financial aid priority deadline is February 1, 2027; final Fall deadline is May 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: For Fall: May 1st | For Financial Aid Priority Consideration: February 1st

gre_general.value: The general GRE is recommended for Civil Engineering PhD applicants (not strictly required per CCNY admissions).
gre_general.quote: The general Graduate Record Examination is recommended.

also.quote: GRE Required: Recommended, but not required

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Civil Engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT 79-80 (4.5 updated scale); PTE 53 and Duolingo 100 are also accepted.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum Language Test Scores: 79-80 (TOEFL IBT), 4.5 (TOEFL updated scale), 6.5 (IELTS), 53 (PTE), 100 (Duolingo)

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic band score is 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum Language Test Scores: 79-80 (TOEFL IBT), 4.5 (TOEFL updated scale), 6.5 (IELTS), 53 (PTE), 100 (Duolingo)

supervisor.value: Not stated on the Civil Engineering PhD pages checked.

funding.value: Five-year CCNY/GSOE fellowships ($41,331 annual stipend, health benefits, and full tuition) are available on a competitive basis alongside outside funding.
funding.quote: The program provides a 5-year CCNY Fellowship which includes a $41,331 stipend per year, health benefits, and full tuition for in-state and out-of-state residents. In addition, outside funding is available. The programs are prestigious and highly competitive.

entry_route.value: Applicants with either a bachelor's or master's degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related field are eligible; master's holders may transfer up to 30 credits.
entry_route.quote: To be eligible for admission, an applicant must possess a bachelor's or master's degree in Civil Engineering or in a closely related area appropriate to the intended field of study from an accredited institution.

notes: Specializations: Structural Engineering and Mechanics, Water Resources Environmental Engineering, Transportation.
name: Ph.D. in Civil Engineering
